hypotheses.boundary: Tests an information-processing consequence, not a universal ontology.
hypotheses.design: Randomized channel degradation with fixed labels; report mutual information, calibration and error rate.
hypotheses.hypothesis: For a preregistered classification task, decreasing the distinguishability of task-relevant states monotonically decreases usable information and classification accuracy.
hypotheses.refutation: No relevant loss, or a robust improvement, across the defined degradation range.
hypotheses.support: Negative monotonic trend beyond the preregistered equivalence margin.

hypotheses.boundary: Tests conceptual discipline; it does not prove one metaphysical theory.
hypotheses.design: Randomized vignette study with relational versus interventional definitions.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Blind reviewers who receive an explicit intervention criterion classify fewer merely relational links as causal than reviewers given relation language alone.
hypotheses.support: Lower false-positive causal classification with unchanged true-positive sensitivity.

hypotheses.boundary: Integrity does not establish semantic truth.
hypotheses.design: Controlled repository experiment with known insertions, deletions and reorderings.
hypotheses.hypothesis: A complete hash-linked provenance chain improves tamper detection and reconstruction accuracy relative to a mutable unversioned record set.
hypotheses.refutation: No advantage over the control condition.
hypotheses.support: Higher sensitivity and lower reconstruction error at controlled false-positive rate.

hypotheses.boundary: Does not by itself establish intent, deception or legal liability.
hypotheses.design: Predefined memory tasks across sessions; compare claimed persistence, retrievability and receipt consistency.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Systems required to emit retrieval-tested persistence receipts make fewer unsupported persistence claims than systems that answer from conversational state without a receipt gate.
hypotheses.refutation: No reduction in unsupported claims or no improvement in retrieval.
hypotheses.support: Lower unsupported-claim rate and higher later retrieval under the receipt gate.

hypotheses.boundary: Tests present reception, not physical retrocausality.
hypotheses.design: Randomized controlled exposure with source provenance and delayed decision measurement.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Exposure to a source-bound historical artifact changes a preregistered present decision distribution relative to an information-matched control.
hypotheses.refutation: Equivalence within the preregistered effect margin.
hypotheses.support: Replicable present-decision effect while all physical interventions remain forward ordered.

hypotheses.boundary: An educational hypothesis, not a new physical mechanism.
hypotheses.design: Randomized instructional study with transfer questions and delayed retest.
hypotheses.hypothesis: An intervention separating uncertainty relations from relativistic causal cones reduces false inferences from quantum uncertainty to retrocausal signalling.
hypotheses.refutation: No improvement or a trade-off that worsens core understanding.
hypotheses.support: Lower misconception score with preserved understanding of both concepts.

hypotheses.boundary: Operationalizes the aphorism without treating its wording as a theorem.
hypotheses.design: Blind scoring of standardized practical tasks plus self-report baseline.
hypotheses.hypothesis: In a bounded practical skill, observed task performance predicts later competence ratings better than self-description alone.
hypotheses.support: Out-of-sample predictive improvement from observed performance.
